negative_reviews.author: Sadia Rahman
negative_reviews.text: I visited yesterday after seeing the lunch menu on instagram, however we weren’t offered the lunch menu. After over half an hour of waiting for staff to come to our table, we approached them asking about the menu. After another 10 mins or so of waiting, we approached wait staff again to place our order. The food came out quickly but it was nothing special. Other tables had arrived, ate and left but we were waiting for staff to come to our table majority of the time. At the end we had to approach staff again to pay for the bill as they would not come to our table. Usually you would make eye contact or wave but no one would look in our direction. They also billed us for individual items and we had to correct them about the lunch offer. Service charge was also added despite the lack of service. I don’t know what’s more disappointing the lack of transparency about their companies offers or that the staff aren’t attentive towards paying customers. I do not recommend and will not be returning.
